title: Parent-before-child numbering of refinement trees
statement: Let W be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], allowed a predicate on complementary open/closed splits, and P a predicate on structural maps to W. A recursive scheme refinement tree [def-fix-scheme-refinement-tree] rooted at the identity of W, satisfying AllLeaves P, admits a numbering by Fin N. The root scheme is isomorphic to W over W; every nonroot vertex has a strictly smaller parent, is one of that parent’s two children, and the leaves are exactly vertices without proper children. Every internal vertex has distinct later left and right children, with complementary quasi-compact open and closed edge morphisms and an allowed split. Structural maps commute with edges. All vertices are quasi-compact and quasi-separated and immersed in W. Leaf images are pairwise disjoint and cover W, and P holds at every leaf.

source.place: Tag 09Y4, lemma-constructible-partition-refined-by-stratification; scheme-theoretic finite binary refinement bookkeeping in the item proof steps 6–9

proof.text: Induct on the tree, constructing a finite linear order of labels: one singleton for a tip, and the lexicographic sum of a new root with the two subtree orders at a node. Reset child-root parents to the new root and retain all other parents. Derive parent and child inequalities from the lexicographic order. Carry the schemes, edges, admissibility and leaf predicates from the constructors. Covering follows by choosing the complementary child containing a point. Cross-subtree disjointness follows from complementary child images and injectivity of the structural immersion; within each subtree use induction. Characterize leaves by their self-children and strict parent inequalities. Apply Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq and transport all data and properties along this order isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_fin_encoding
    {W : Scheme.{u}}
    {allowed : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}), (T ⟶ W) → ∀ (L R : Scheme.{u}),
      (L ⟶ T) → (R ⟶ T) → Prop}
    {P : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}), (T ⟶ W) → Prop}
    (tree : SchemeRefinementTree W allowed W (𝟙 W))
    (htree : AllLeaves P tree) :
      ∃ (N : ℕ) (V : Fin N → Scheme.{u}) (toW : ∀ v : Fin N, V v ⟶ W)
        (root : Fin N) (parent left right : Fin N → Fin N)
        (leftEdge : ∀ v : Fin N, V (left v) ⟶ V v)
        (rightEdge : ∀ v : Fin N, V (right v) ⟶ V v)
        (leaf : Fin N → Prop),
        (∃ e : V root ≅ W, e.hom = toW root) ∧ parent root = root ∧
        (∀ v, v ≠ root → (parent v).val < v.val) ∧
        (∀ v, ¬ leaf v → leftEdge v ≫ toW v = toW (left v)) ∧
        (∀ v, ¬ leaf v → rightEdge v ≫ toW v = toW (right v)) ∧
        (∀ v, CompactSpace (V v)) ∧
        (∀ v, QuasiSeparatedSpace (V v)) ∧
        (∀ v, IsImmersion (toW v)) ∧
        (∀ v, v ≠ root →
          left (parent v) = v ∨ right (parent v) = v) ∧
        (∀ v, leaf v ↔ ∀ w, w ≠ root → parent w ≠ v) ∧
        (∀ v, ¬ leaf v → left v ≠ right v ∧
          v.val < (left v).val ∧ v.val < (right v).val ∧
          parent (left v) = v ∧ parent (right v) = v ∧
          IsOpenImmersion (leftEdge v) ∧
          IsClosedImmersion (rightEdge v) ∧
          QuasiCompact (leftEdge v) ∧ QuasiCompact (rightEdge v) ∧
          Set.range (leftEdge v).base ∪ Set.range (rightEdge v).base = Set.univ ∧
          Disjoint (Set.range (leftEdge v).base)
            (Set.range (rightEdge v).base)) ∧
        (∀ v, ¬ leaf v →
          allowed (V v) (toW v) (V (left v)) (V (right v))
            (leftEdge v) (rightEdge v)) ∧
        (∀ x : W, ∃ v : Fin N, leaf v ∧ Nonempty (V v) ∧
          x ∈ Set.range (toW v).base) ∧
        (∀ v w, leaf v → leaf w → v ≠ w →
          Disjoint (Set.range (toW v).base) (Set.range (toW w).base)) ∧
        (∀ v, leaf v → P (V v) (toW v))
